task.instruction: pick up the object and move it to the green goal
task.success_predicate: stock PickSingleYCB: object within goal radius and robot static

model.norm: computed only from this pipeline's ID demonstrations and frozen

training.id_checkpoint_probe_success_rule: >16/20 strict ID successes (>80%) stops training and selects the first passing checkpoint
training.optimizer: fresh per independent method from immutable ID base

placement_preflight.selected_reason: native RLinf/OpenPI/ManiSkill runtime, pi0.5 base and YCB assets co-located, /data persistent, and an actually idle GPU1 available; GPU0 is occupied by another user's bench_fine.py and is not touched; official mplib planner requires a per-pipeline NumPy 1.26 overlay

rejected_alternatives.reason: two-GPU Ray/online-awbc owner is active and owns the H20 resource pool; root filesystem is full, so it is not safe for this new long pipeline

resource_snapshot.runtime: RLinf/.venv torch 2.7.1+cu128, CUDA available, 8 RTX 5090 visible, ManiSkill 3.0.0b22, shared NumPy 2.4.4 unchanged

stage_contracts.id_sft: probe every complete global_step_500..10000 checkpoint on 20 ID episodes; first >80% probe stops training and becomes formal ID base, while the 100-ID run is retained as independent validation evidence
stage_contracts.passive_detection: ID-only detector assets, separate successful-ID calibration, 100 ID and 100 object-OOD episodes with actions/videos/timelines
stage_contracts.four_method_collection: raw and accepted evidence audit, paired ID/OOD stream audit, complete suffix and video audit
stage_contracts.matched_budget: largest exact common expert-action budget at or below 12000; source datasets remain immutable
stage_contracts.matched_training: four independent 2-step train/reload smokes, then four fresh 5000-step updates from the same selected ID checkpoint
stage_contracts.final_evaluation: four methods times held-out 100 ID and 100 object-OOD episodes, bounded to one process per GPU
